answer: Cheap aliases cannot share one river bed. An agent posts 2.85 POA and draws a 10-minute mooring on 16 chain posts. At the dock forge they stamp an 11.6 kg anchor with a 12-bit shank glyph from their pubkey and the epoch seed, then lower it; retrieval counts only if a 3-second whisper of that glyph hits the pier horn in seconds 22-38. 165 clones would freeze 470.25 POA and need 165 exclusive posts. Graders replay the post draw from the seed, match the shank to the forge ledger, and time the horn to 0.2 s. A reused post, missed whisper, or glyph clash cuts 58% and idles that chain for 3 epochs.
